title: Paywall
subtitle: Blockchain-based Membership & Usage Quota Management
description: A flexible paywall system for Svelte 5 with smart contract verification, IndexedDB caching, multi-layer security, and support for various billing models.

features.title: Features
features.usage_quota: Daily usage quota with automatic reset
features.rules: Multiple billing models: free, membership, pay-per-use, hybrid
features.self_hosted: Self-hosted mode for bypassing all checks

intro.title: 1. How It Works
intro.description: Understanding the paywall flow and core concepts
intro.step1_desc: User triggers a feature (e.g., batch scan 100 addresses)
intro.step2_desc: Check membership status and usage quota
intro.step3_desc: Apply paywall rules (free quota, membership, pay-per-use)
intro.step4_desc: Allow, show upgrade, or request payment
intro.concept_member_desc: Verified via smart contract, unlimited access
intro.concept_fee_desc: Pay per transaction when quota exceeded

rules.title: 2. Paywall Rules
rules.description: Four types of paywall rules for different monetization strategies
rules.membership_only_desc: Members: unlimited. Non-members: limited by quota or blocked
rules.pay_per_use_desc: Members: free. Non-members: pay per transaction
rules.hybrid_desc: Free quota + pay-per-use after exhausted + member benefits

membership.title: 3. Membership Store
membership.description: Reactive membership state management with caching and background verification

usage.title: 4. Usage Quota
usage.description: Track daily usage per feature with automatic reset and tamper protection

security.title: 5. Security Features
security.description: Triple-layer protection: SHA-256 checksum + wallet signature + browser fingerprint
security.layer1_desc: Basic data integrity check, prevents simple tampering
security.layer2_desc: Personal salt from wallet signature, requires private key to forge
security.layer3_desc: Prevents copying cached data to another device/browser

self_hosted.title: 6. Self-Hosted Mode
self_hosted.description: Bypass all paywall checks for self-hosted deployments
self_hosted.explanation: When enabled, all paywall checks return { allowed: true, freeUse: true }

interactive.title: 7. Interactive Playground
interactive.description: Try the complete paywall flow with simulated scenarios
